messages:
vivian: RCA published: Embedding cache divergence during a config rollout — https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-4998
vivian: TL;DR: a config skew between embedding workers caused inconsistent SHA-based cache keys, leading to higher miss rates and degraded similarity scores for ~7% of embedding requests for ~40m.
vivian: Immediate mitigations: paused rollout, synced manifests across regions, and backfilled missing cache entries for affected pools.
omar: Can we list the concrete action items and quick owners so we can close the loop?
vivian: Action items:
- E1: Normalize cache key derivation across worker variants (owner: sanjay)
- E2: Add manifest consistency check in the artifact pipeline (owner: omar)
- E3: Add an alert for sudden embedding similarity drift (>2 sigma) (owner: infra-bot)
- E4: Customer outreach note + support playbook (owner: vivian)
sanjay: Taking E1. Will produce a small compatibility shim and unit tests. ETA: 2025-05-13.
omar: Taking E2. Will add a CI job to verify manifest hashes across regions. ETA: 2025-05-12.
infra-bot: E3 scheduled: Grafana panel and low-sev alert will be added; linking in RCA once live.
vivian: Checkpoints: 1-week status sync 2025-05-16 09:00 PT, 30-day review 2025-06-13 09:00 PT. Invites sent.
incident-bot: RCA RC-4998 created by vivian. Title: "Embedding cache key divergence during rollout" https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-4998
omar: Please paste PR links here as they land so we can mark them in the RCA.
sanjay: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/912 (cache key normalization)
omar: CI manifest check PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/artifacts/pull/78
vivian: I'll coordinate the customer note and post updates before the 1-week checkpoint.
infra-bot: Dashboard panel added and linked in RCA.
vivian: Thanks team. Closing thread for now; tracking continues in the RCA and via PRs. :white_check_mark:
